title.zh: 将莱特省从蒂格包（塔克洛班）经帕斯特拉纳、达加米与塔纳万至圣菲的公路命名为Filomeno Montejo公路的法案
title.en: An Act Naming the Road From Tigbao (Tacloban) to Sta. Fe, Pastrana, Dagami and Tanauan, Province of Leyte, as Filomeno Montejo Highway
title.orig: An Act Naming the Road From Tigbao (Tacloban) to Sta. Fe, Pastrana, Dagami and Tanauan, Province of Leyte, as Filomeno Montejo Highway

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_8028_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The road starting from Tigbao (Tacloban) to Sta. Fe, Pastrana, Dagami and Tanauan (Junction of Pan-Philippine Highway), Province of Leyte, shall be known as the Filomeno Montejo Highway.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
